verdict.rationale: dlt is a Python data-loading library, not an agent that calls tools, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product role. The evidence shows only the opposite direction: dlt ships an MCP server and an AI Harness that external coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) consume. Nothing shows dlt itself plugging in MCP servers to use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
